data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 旧物盒里的回忆
data.description: 她跪坐在储藏室打开旧木盒，里面是与青梅竹马儿时的小物件；拿起一枚旧发卡端详许久，表情是深居高塔的人独有的、漫长的怀念。
data.action: 她跪坐在储藏室打开旧木盒，里面是与青梅竹马儿时的小物件
data.promptProse: Elfaria Alvis Serfort kneels in the storage room, opening an old wooden box of childhood keepsakes and lifting a worn hair clip for a long examination. Her blue sweater and cream skirt stay relaxed around the pose, expression distant with recollection. The medium portrait includes the box lid and stacked storage shelves behind. Lamplight illuminates the clip and her long blue hair, with deep lid shadows preserving the box's interior layers.
